The '''Combat Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked at {{coll|Rotten Flesh 2}}, {{coll|Rotten Flesh 5}}, {{coll|Rotten Flesh 7}}, {{coll|Rotten Flesh 9}}, and {{Coll|Rotten Flesh 10}} with increasing capacity. Beginner Sack holds {{Green|640}} items, but only includes early game resources.

== Obtaining ==
=== Merchant ===
A '''Beginner Combat Sack''' can be bought for {{c|250}} at {{NPCSprite|Combat Merchant}} in the [[Hub]] near the {{Zone|Combat Settlement}}.
